skills.name: HostInvestigation
skills.initiation: When an assigned host has suspicious process/connection events that need investigation.
policy: Identify an assigned host with observable suspicious events.
Analyse that host.
Wait for completion and inspect the actual result before escalation.
skills.termination: Analysis has completed and its observable findings have been inspected, or no relevant host remains.

skills.name: ThreatRemoval
skills.initiation: When observable events support a user-level compromise or a malicious process on an assigned host.
policy: Check the affected host and previous analysis/monitor evidence.
Remove malicious processes on that host.
Verify the returned status; re-analyse if evidence is inconclusive.
skills.termination: Removal completed and subsequent observations no longer support the same malicious process, or removal failed and further analysis is needed.

skills.name: HostRecovery
skills.initiation: When an assigned host has observable admin-level compromise and removal is insufficient.
policy: Confirm observable admin-compromise evidence on the specific host.
Restore the host, considering its availability cost.
Wait for the restore action and check the observed result.
skills.termination: Restore has completed with observable confirmation, or the action has failed.

skills.name: DeceptionDeployment
skills.initiation: When the defender is available and a legitimate assigned host can host a useful decoy.
policy: Choose a valid assigned host without repeating a failed deployment blindly.
DeployDecoy on the host.
Wait for completion and examine status and subsequent monitor events.
skills.termination: Deployment has completed or failed and its result has been checked.

skills.name: NetworkContainment
skills.initiation: When observable repeated malicious connections or communicated threat justify limiting a zone.
policy: Check the visible mission phase and relevant communication vectors.
Choose a valid subnet for BlockTrafficZone without gratuitous availability loss.
Observe success/failure and reassess the containment need.
skills.termination: The block action result is known and the immediate containment decision has been reassessed.

skills.name: TrafficRecovery
skills.initiation: When the defender has observable evidence of its previous traffic block and can reassess its need.
policy: Identify the previously blocked subnet from observed action history.
Check current phase and available threat evidence.
AllowTrafficZone when recovery is justified and check the actual status.
skills.termination: Traffic restoration has completed or failed and its result has been inspected.

skills.name: WaitVerification
skills.initiation: When an action is still in progress or an already initiated response must be checked before another intervention.
policy: Inspect Last Action Status and the busy bit.
Sleep while the previous action remains in progress.
Read the completed action status and automatic Monitor observations before continuing.
skills.termination: The outstanding action has completed and its observable outcome is available.

skills.name: HostRecovery_v2
skills.initiation: IF observable admin-level compromise evidence is confirmed on the host AND the host is the correct target of the restore action AND removal of the compromised state is insufficient
policy: Verify the exact compromised host through evidence analysis and cross-check with incident data
Confirm the restoration target matches the compromised host before initiating the restore action
Execute the restore action and wait for confirmation of successful restoration
Validate the host's restored state through observable metrics and functional tests
skills.termination: Stop IF the correct host has been successfully restored with observable confirmation AND the host is functioning as expected
